chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Muhammad ibn Mudabbir, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'O Muhammad, take this slave girl; she will serve you and you may have sexual relations with her. So when you go out, return her to us.'

key_terms.وَتُصِيبُ مِنْهَا: And you may have sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on lending a female slave to another Muslim?
ai.summary: This hadith from *al-Istibsar* elucidates the permissibility of *Ihla* (lending a female slave) within the Shia tradition, demonstrating a practical application of ownership rights where the lender retains ultimate authority. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) explicitly grants Muhammad ibn Mudabbir both domestic service and sexual intimacy (*istimta'*) with the slave, highlighting the distinct status of concubinage in early Islamic society. The instruction to return her upon departure underscores the temporary nature of this arrangement and the flexibility of marital-like relations outside formal marriage contracts.
